nodes.label: Feature vs SyncNet Delta Scatter
nodes.content: Two horizontal bar charts: Sync-C delta (TTS-Natural) and Sync-D delta across viseme metrics from Hubert L0/L6/L11 layers (raw and gain_matched). Sync-C overall delta: +0.692 (TTS slightly better). Sync-D overall delta: -0.445 (natural better). L0 boundary_sharpness shows TTS advantage in both metrics. Higher-layer metrics (L6, L11) and silhouette scores show natural superiority for Sync-D. Demonstrates that TTS matches natural at low-level boundary features but lags in higher-level cluster coherence.
